phase_title: Workflow Router Screen Correction and Guided Current Action UI
title: Durable Current Required Action Model
problem: ChampCity A/I still behaves like a collection of screens rather than a workflow router. The app needs a durable current required action model that reads project artifacts and determines what the Operator should do next.
goal: Implement a deterministic current required action model that computes the current workflow step from durable project state.
included_scope: Create a durable current required action model/type for the locked workflow
Add deterministic workflow-step evaluation from durable project artifacts
Represent current workflow step, responsible role, source evidence, expected output, success route, failure/repair route, manual fallback route, and warnings
Add support for Phase 03 state after WC01 validation

Distinguish mapped candidates, ready-for-implementer Work Cards, Implementer Reports, Architect reviews, Operator validations, repairs, completed-via-repair, carried-forward, deferred, and cancelled states
Treat superseded artifacts as warnings/context rather than active authority
Handle missing or stale validation target files without crashing or routing incorrectly
Add compatibility handling for current Phase 03 Work Card JSON shape where legacy validation target schema expects older fields
Add fixture/static test coverage for current-action calculation across major workflow states
Create WC02 Implementer Report under planning/phases/phase-03/Builder_Reports/
out_of_scope: Do not implement the Figma workflow-router UI shell
Do not perform broad visual redesign
Do not replace the renderer with the Figma prototype
Do not implement every route-specific screen correction
Do not create WC03 or later executable Work Cards
Do not create a separate Implementer Prompt artifact
Do not perform Operator validation or create validation records
Do not package, tag, release, deploy, push, or create a PR
acceptance_criteria: A typed/shared current required action model exists
A deterministic evaluator computes the current required action from durable project state
The evaluator identifies Phase 03 / WC02 as the current actionable state after WC01 validation
The evaluator can distinguish completed WC01 from active/current WC02
The evaluator can identify when the next mapped candidate needs a full Work Card
The evaluator can identify when an Implementer Report requires Architect review
The evaluator can identify when Operator validation is required
The evaluator can identify when repair sub-card creation is required
The evaluator can identify when Phase Closeout is required
Superseded Phase 03 artifacts are surfaced as warnings/context, not active authority
Missing stale validation target files do not crash current-action evaluation
The Human Validation stale target/schema issue is resolved at the model/reader layer or explicitly documented as residual route-level work
Fixture/static validation covers the major workflow states listed in the Work Card
A WC02 Implementer Report exists under planning/phases/phase-03/Builder_Reports/ after implementation
validation_expectations: Run TypeScript/type validation if source code changes
Run npm run validate:codex unless the validation lane document instructs otherwise
Run fixture/static validation for current-action model scenarios
Run node --check scripts/verify-work-card-fixture.mjs if that script or related fixture assumptions are affected
Run git status --short and report changed files
Do not perform Operator acceptance or create validation records
